column2: If I wanted to, I could leave this cell whenever I pleased!
When you speak ill of me, I wish you would do it loudly and openly!
When someone speaks ill of another, it usually means...
that deep down, they harbor $$嫉妬$$ of that person's excellence—
And for today, you all ought to turn in soon.
If you keep making a racket, that cowardly guard trembling over there...
will get hurt again, and I can hardly bear to watch it.
Surely you do not truly wish to keep standing by...
and watching the weak be bullied, do you?
